title: GoodBoy
description: Pet players with a keybind ! Make the server your good little boys
body:
This lets you **_“pet”_** other players in a fun and silly way inside the game. It is a joke feature that makes the game more funny and playful. When you use it, your character can interact with other players like they are friendly pets. It is not serious, it is just for fun and laughs.

![How it looks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/499302ea8086cab6a838c01741e2e5b8b38200e5_0.webp)

Default key is B you can configure it in keybinds settings

![Config Key](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bad3e70d06a6b0bb36d68615b74ba2b8424f9227_0.webp)
